historic/u1e5/guaman-poma-miner.jpg.description: 1615 Guamán Poma de Ayala drawing 'Corregidor de minas' showing the cruel punishment of Indigenous mine workers (manuscript p. 529).

historic/u1e5/jean-bodin.jpg.description: 1586 title page of Jean Bodin's 'De Republica libri sex' (Six Books of the Republic), the work behind his quantity theory of money.

historic/u1e5/manila-galleon.jpg.description: 1743 painting of the Spanish galleon Nuestra Señora de Covadonga, which sailed the Manila galleon route, under capture.

historic/u1e5/mercury-patio.jpg.description: 19th-century photograph of the mercury-amalgamation patio process, with mules treading ore pulp in a walled patio.

historic/u1e5/ming-porcelain.jpg.description: Ming dynasty Chinese porcelain jar with floral decoration, the luxury good traded east for American silver.

historic/u1e5/mita-miners.jpg.description: 18th-century engraving of a cross-section of a Potosí silver mine with miners digging, climbing ladders, and hauling ore.

historic/u1e5/pacific-galleon-route.jpg.description: 1748 Anson chart of the Pacific Ocean marking the Spanish galleon's track between Manila and Acapulco.

historic/u1e5/philip-ii.jpg.description: Workshop of Titian portrait of Philip II of Spain in black with the Order of the Golden Fleece (Museo del Prado).

historic/u1e5/pieces-of-eight.jpg.description: Obverse and reverse of a Spanish colonial 8-reales silver cob coin of Philip IV, the 'piece of eight.'

historic/u1e5/pillars-hercules-coin.jpg.description: Engraving of a 1661 pillar dollar showing the Pillars of Hercules with the PLVS VLTRA banner, origin of the dollar sign.

historic/u1e5/potosi-cerro-rico.jpg.description: The conical Cerro Rico silver mountain looming over the rooftops of Potosí, Bolivia.

historic/u1e5/potosi-city-view.jpg.description: 16th-century woodcut 'Cerro del Potosí' showing the city at the foot of the silver mountain.

historic/u1e5/potosi-mint.jpg.description: Historic photograph of the Casa de la Moneda (royal mint) building in Potosí.

historic/u1e5/silver-ingots.jpg.description: 1897 photograph of stacked silver bullion bars in a vault.

historic/u1e5/toledo-viceroy.jpg.description: Colonial portrait of Francisco de Toledo, Viceroy of Peru, who organized the mita labor system.
